description: Defines the StreamedSnapshot class, a serializable message representing streamed snapshots with JSON serialization/deserialization, including entity ID and snapshot data.

classes.name: StreamedSnapshot
classes.description: A final class implementing StreamingMessage and Jsonifiable, representing a streamed snapshot with entity ID and JSON snapshot data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new StreamedSnapshot instance from an EntityId and a JsonObject snapshot.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a StreamedSnapshot from a JsonObject.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the snapshot.

methods.name: getSnapshot
methods.description: Returns the snapshot as a JsonObject.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the StreamedSnapshot to a JsonObject.
